title: Composition and locale implementation mapping
summary: Configuration inheritance, content-owned locale routing and current composition boundaries through the M5 product fixture.
current_behavior: Configuration resolves defaults, docara.json, every section.json from root to leaf and an optional page sidecar with pointer-level provenance.
LocaleRegistry supports arbitrary well-formed locale definitions, prefixes, fallbacks and direction.
The public documentation site declares only ru content; a minimal physical English LTR and Arabic RTL consumer fixture proves the same engine without claiming translation coverage.
DeclarativePageCompiler resolves region composition through one DesignRegistry into descriptor-owned layout regions, sections and blocks without concrete design or Smart IDs.
Package and project design providers have exclusive namespaces, deterministic precedence and fail-closed duplicate/path/symlink rules.
Preview uses PortableSiteBuilder production services, carries typed preview build purpose, publishes its required local assets without a production receipt and is rejected by production verification.
M1B provides docara.lang.v1 and a fail-closed target validator.
Public builds load shared UI messages only from content/<locale>/lang.json and fail without the selected locale file; package presentation fallback is absent.
FrontMatterParser implements title, description, tags, draft and translation_key with source line/column diagnostics.
locales.missing_page_policy is explicit: skip publishes only physical owners and error fails with LOCALE_PAGE_MISSING.
Reader settings expose only allowlisted UI-radius presets over Framework-owned tokens; arbitrary CSS remains outside project configuration.
known_deviations: Page-sidecar title and description remain a pre-release compatibility surface; new authoring uses front matter.
The shipped documentation site remains Russian-only; the English and Arabic trees are deliberately minimal product fixtures, not translated documentation.
The former global source_ownership gate-order conflict is resolved by DOC-ADR-015 and badge_source_ready.
deletion_gates: Remove generated-base config resolution only after all public generated routes have physical sources.
Remove remaining page-sidecar prose fields only with an explicit consumer migration and parity proof.
Do not claim a locale as public documentation until its complete physical Markdown and lang.json ownership matrix passes.
